description_for_human: Read sales summaries and resolve authorized workspaces in X1 HQ.

functions.name: get_mcp_gateway_status
functions.description: Return the safe operator status, circuit-breaker impact, policy epoch, and schema marker for the current action list.

functions.name: bootstrap_hq_workspace
functions.description: Start an authenticated X1 HQ connection by resolving the user's workspace and optional company, brand, or shop names. Selects and persists a unique match; otherwise returns the shortest candidate list the user must disambiguate. Call this before any non-bootstrap HQ tool.

functions.name: get_brand_sales_summary
functions.description: Return a normalized sales summary for a brand and optional shop subset over a requested date range.

tools.name: get_mcp_gateway_status
tools.description: Return the safe operator status, circuit-breaker impact, policy epoch, and schema marker for the current action list.

tools.name: bootstrap_hq_workspace
tools.description: Start an authenticated X1 HQ connection by resolving the user's workspace and optional company, brand, or shop names. Selects and persists a unique match; otherwise returns the shortest candidate list the user must disambiguate. Call this before any non-bootstrap HQ tool.

workspaceName.description: Optional workspace name supplied by the user.

companyName.description: Optional company name supplied by the user.

brandName.description: Optional brand name supplied by the user.

shopName.description: Optional shop name supplied by the user.

tools.name: get_brand_sales_summary
tools.description: Return a normalized sales summary for a brand and optional shop subset over a requested date range.

fromDate.description: Calendar date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

toDate.description: Calendar date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

shopIds.description: Optional list of HQ shop identifiers.
